The clean sweep is at candidate 2 of 20 and matching the first run exactly, so it's deterministic — it just needs its ~40 minutes. Everything that doesn't depend on it is finished and mechanically checked.

While waiting I tightened three things that were still resting on the extractor's own words rather than on my measurement:

- **The batch boundary** (`515..729`) now comes from `git show 671b6f3:bitacora/VEREDICTOS.jsonl | wc -l` instead of from the figure the encargo quoted.
- **The five closest neighbours** in my classification: I read their `entregable_esperado` from their own fichas. Four separate cleanly. The fifth, `pedir_critica_equipo_premiarla`, delivers *"con todo el equipo enterado de que la queja se atendio"* against `premiar_franqueza`'s list told publicly — **they genuinely touch**, and I wrote that into the file rather than around it. I hold them apart under `6.1` because what falls outside the overlap is procedure on both sides, and the discutible flag is earned rather than decorative.
- **Manual 3.4**, which is the rule the vuelta uses to refuse the eight aristas: I censused the graph and exactly **one** node compresses that numbering (13 hijos, 14 pasos); the other thirteen each name only their own position. An arista between two siblings cites a paso, it doesn't compress a list. That doesn't settle the doctrine — that's the acta's job — but it removes the measurable half of the argument, and I said so in those terms.

I also recorded, in the file, that I ran the neighbour sweep three times and that **only the third counts**: the first used my own text builder instead of the house's `comun.texto_comparable` and returned `0` neighbours for everything. That instrument was copied from my own `.a36/vecinos_rapido.py`. Publishing that zero would have been a `CIFRA PUBLICADA PROPIA` of exactly the family `D.38.5` exists to catch, and it was caught by checking the instrument against `src/aduana.py`, not by luck.
